'''Lightweight Knuckled Protocol Hands''' were [[Human/Legends|Human]]-inspired grasping parts for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] designed by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. Such lightweight, five-fingered hands were well-suited for [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]], including the popular [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]].
